integrity: The algebra reduces Youden ranking to TP+TN and expresses diagnostic odds ratio at fixed TP+TN as a strictly decreasing function of TP times TN. A separate exact-rational verifier exhausts every admissible table through the first boundary, checks the fixed-level extrema, and replays the explicit infinite family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to balanced binary diagnostic studies, strictly positive confusion-matrix cells, positive discrimination, and exact integer counts. It does not cover continuity-corrected diagnostic odds ratios, unequal case-control totals, threshold uncertainty, or decision-theoretic weighting of error types.
title: Youden and diagnostic odds ratio first reverse with ten cases and ten controls
